state:
**Goal `ext-design`: Stage 3, the world text, has landed and its six tests are green. Stage 4, the image interface, is next.** The design is settled by ADR 0246, ADR 0247 and the goal file's § *Standing decisions*. None of it is re-decided.

Stage 2 is on disk in `benches/abi-probe` behind `wasm-probe` (`tests/wasm_async.rs`), and `rule:packaging/a-guest-call-yields-on-its-core` says so. Record slot (b) is not used.

Stage 3 is on disk. `wit/nvs-ext/` has `types.wit`, `log.wit`, `settings.wit` and `world.wit` (the `extension` world). Its `deps/` has the seven WASI 0.2.12 WIT files, copied unchanged from the `wasip2` crate in the cargo registry. `sockets.wit` is there only because `cli.wit`'s own worlds name it, and the `extension` world does not import it. `crates/nvs-stdlib/tests/ext_world.rs` holds the six named tests. `CROSSES` gives ten `Core` value classes a record: `BigInt`, `Uuid`, `Uri`, `Crypto\PublicKey` and six `Time` classes. `REFUSED` gives each of the other value classes one sentence. `ALLOWED_IMPORTS` is the resolved world's exact import set. `wit-parser` 0.254 is a dev-dependency of `nvs-stdlib` only, with `default-features = false, features = ["std"]`, and the lock gained one edge and no crate. The three packaging rules' *Not on disk* paragraphs now name the world and its test.

Not checked: which WASI 0.2 release wasmtime 48's own WASI crate defines. That crate is not in the lock. `world.wit`'s comment relies on wasmtime's linker resolving an older 0.2 import to a newer definition (`wasmtime-48.0.5/src/runtime/component/linker.rs:41`). Goal `ext-host` links WASI and is where a mismatch would show.

The goal file's anchors into `crates/nvs-stdlib/src/registry.rs` have drifted: `CoreClass::slots` is now `:1643` and `CLASSES` is `:1735`.

next.title: the image interface
next.note: one file set: a new `wit/image.wit`, `crates/nvs-stdlib/tests/ext_world.rs`; read only `docs/decisions/0120.md` §§ 2, 3 and 8.

items.text: **`wit/image.wit`** — package `nvs:image@1.0.0`, interface `codec` with the eight exports of `docs/decisions/0120.md:166` (§ 3), each returning `result<T, error>` with `nvs:ext/types`' `error`, and a world `image` that includes `nvs:ext/extension` and exports `codec`. An overlay is a flat table of pipelines that a `composite` step indexes, because WIT has no recursive types. `rule:core-classes/image-one-entry-point-per-job`, `rule:core-classes/image-pipeline`.

**Parse it against the world** — extend `world()` at `crates/nvs-stdlib/tests/ext_world.rs:208` or add a second loader that pushes `wit/nvs-ext` first and then `wit/image.wit`, so `use nvs:ext/types@1.0.0` resolves. `check_crossable` at `crates/nvs-stdlib/tests/ext_world.rs:233` already judges a type against the value table, so reuse it for every export's parameters and result.

**The member map test** — every member of 0120 § 2's table and § 8 (`docs/decisions/0120.md:117`, `docs/decisions/0120.md:253`), each with where it runs: an export, a plan step or Novis source. Record slot (a) is used only if `measureText` or `fromRaw` needs a new export or `source` case (goal § *Standing decisions*). `bun nv loop --list --stage 4` names the check.

backlog: `wasi:cli/terminal-*` is not in the world. Whether the wasip1 adapter, or a libc's `isatty`, imports it and so fails to load is not checked. Goal `ext-host` owns that decision when it links WASI (rule:packaging/a-guest-has-no-ambient-authority).

`tools/nv/test/transcript.test.ts:113` ("a freeze stops the child where it stands") failed once on wall-clock time (1822 ms against a floor of 2500) and passed on the re-run. That stopped `nv verify` at step 6. It is a timing flake on Windows, not checked further (tools/nv).
The goal file's `registry.rs:1569` and `:1685` anchors are stale. The prose is deleted at the goal switch, so they are not worth fixing.
